items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: he had a brother, O. B. Davis, who died in New York, he was a great drummer.

ctx.x: Nathaniel C. Davis, yes. He was a very famous man and he had a brother, C. M. Davis, trumpet player and he had a brother, O. B. Davis, who died in New York, he was a great drummer. And he had a sister which was a fine -- they're all a family of musicians.
Now when you were playing in this school band, what sort of music were you playing there?
